breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the boundary condition dy/dx = 0 at x = 0 (the fixed end), not at x = L (the free end). The free end is allowed to rotate, and the slope at the free end is calculated as PL²/(2EI), which is the correct result for a cantilever with an end point load. The incorrect instruction to set free-end rotation to zero has been discarded.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the linearly varying moment equation M(x) = -P(L-x), which varies from -PL at the fixed end (x=0) to 0 at the free end (x=L). This replaces the incorrect assumption of a constant moment equal to PL over the full span. The integration proceeds correctly with this linear moment distribution, yielding the standard cantilever formulas PL²/(2EI) for slope and PL³/(3EI) for deflection.
